senses.gloss: prickly branch of the date palm.—Pl. שֵׁיצִים, שֵׁיצִין, שֵׁצִ׳.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 7:16">Tosef. Shebi. VII, 16</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 53a:6">Pes. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>על של בין הש׳</he> as long as there are dates on the single branches, opp. <he>כפים</he>, v. <cite ref="K00603"><he>כִּיפָּה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:7:5">Y. Sabb. I, 4ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ש׳ שבכפים</he> the stony dates on the top branches; Y. Bets. III, 62ᵃ (not <he>שבכפיס</he>).
